photos.desc: Abeliophyllum distichum In Gyeongbokgung palace, Korea
The shrub Abeliophyllum distichum blooms in March with small flowers.

Location taken: the United States National Arboretum, Washington D.C.. Names: Abeliophyllum distichum Nakai, Abeliophyllum, Abéliovec dvojradý, Korean Abelia-Leaf, White Forsythia, 미선나 Classification:
